title: The report guard resolves a spawn with no model field to its role file's model, and maps a full model id to its short name
why: The report guard read a reviewer spawn with no model field as "ran sonnet", but ~/.claude/agents/reviewer.md sets `model: haiku` and the agent's report said claude-haiku-5-5; that wrong read gave runner 8 a wrong model for #1840's round 1 (03:09 CST, corrected 03:19 CST). It also said no reviewer ran sonnet when round 2 of lane windows-stamp-suite-hang was spawned with model sonnet and reported claude-sonnet-5-5. Sources: lanes comment-check-scans-shell (03:12 CST) and windows-stamp-suite-hang (03:18 CST); coordinator 03:18 and 03:19 CST Nov 8.
note: Fix: when a spawn names no model, the guard reads the model from the role's agent file; it maps a full id such as claude-sonnet-5-5 to its short name before it compares. Red cases first: a reviewer spawn with no model field whose role file says haiku is read as haiku, not sonnet; a report naming claude-sonnet-5-5 counts as sonnet. Control: a spawn with model sonnet and a short-name report passes as today. Related: step report-model-from-role (#1705, reads each agent's served model) and step reviewer-model-hook-latest. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 03:21 CST Nov 8. Third sighting (lane child-repo-archive-scope, about 03:45 CST Nov 8): the guard called a true "reviewer haiku" false; round 1 was a reviewer spawn with no model field (role file haiku, report claude-haiku-5-5), round 2 named sonnet. An earlier refusal (about 03:00 CST) said "no model named for reviewer" while the reviewer still ran. The lane now names the model in every spawn (lane, 04:41 CST). Lane session_013NEJKyh5DtXyHyFdAmQUUz builds it, stacked on #1705 (coordinator, 04:42 CST Nov 8). Possible related false alarm (note report-model-before-compact, on #1921): the Stop hook's model-name check fired 4 times in lane session-worktree-strands-agents on reviewers spawned with model sonnet (lane, 05:20 CST Nov 8). The lane checks whether its fix covers this case. Lane, 05:23 CST Nov 8: PR #1919 reads a full id in Done text ("reviewer claude-sonnet-5-5" counts as sonnet). It does not explain the no-model-field sightings: the role-file pin read was already on main and on #1705, so that cause is unmeasured, and the compaction case (step report-model-across-compact) may be the real cause. #1919 (head 96859a48a) is with runner 8 (lane, 06:00 CST Nov 8). Sighting (lane builder-report-in-head, 06:58 CST Nov 8): the report guard counted a round-2 reviewer as haiku, though the spawn named model sonnet and its report named claude-sonnet-5-5. The 06:58 CST haiku sighting moves to step report-guard-all-spawns (07:20 CST Nov 8). Sighting (lane notes-fix-delete-leftovers, about 00:05 CST Nov 8; coordinator 07:50 CST): reviewer spawns with no model field ran haiku (agents/reviewer.md sets model: haiku; each reported claude-haiku-5-5), but the guard read the missing field as sonnet. The same form fired 'no model named for test-author / builder' (agents/test-author.md: haiku). This is the fix #1919 holds; step report-guard-all-spawns holds the latest-spawn-only form. Incident (lane runner-drops-handed-lane, session_013NEJKyzg9A9SDZ926jRCSU, 15:26 CST Nov 8; it proposed step model-guard-no-model-spawn, folded here): on #2260 at 15:21 CST the Stop-hook guard read a reviewer spawn with no `model` field as Sonnet and refused "reviewer haiku". The lane followed it and wrote a false round 1 model into a review record, which the coordinator voided. Harm: false model lines in review records and reports. Steps model-guard-default-model (ready) and report-guard-spawn-model (doing) cover the same cause. Folded (coordinator 15:29 CST Nov 8) into lane report-guard-spawn-model (session_013NEJL3DwgdW1HVejfR77Se); step report-guard-spawn-model carries the work. Closes when #2307 merges (step report-guard-spawn-model; coordinator 16:30 CST Nov 8), not before.
